canonical_project: Safaricom Ethiopia Addis core prefabricated data centre (Kality)
notes: Prefabricated core data centre deployed for Safaricom Ethiopia's 2022 network launch; Addis Fortune reported a USD 100m facility assembled in China and shipped via Djibouti. Directory lists Safaricom Kality Data Centre at Kebele 43, Akaky Kaliti, Addis Ababa. Capacity not disclosed.
